name: Blinn-Phong Relighting
definition: Uses Blinn-Phong shading model to allow real-time lighting adjustments by scaling parameters ka, kd, ks, and beta.
summary: Blinn-Phong Relighting adjusts scene illumination in real-time by scaling Blinn-Phong parameters, differing from PBR by using a simplified, computationally cheaper specular term.
